candidates.reason: Existing unit tests for scrapy.utils.python own callable introspection (test_get_func_args) and are where the partial() fix is exercised; the current partial cases bind None, so a partial bound to a string equal to a parameter name is still uncovered.

scrapy.utils.ssl has no dedicated test module at the base commit; the repository convention test_utils_<module>.py is where the ffi_buf_to_string() self-recursion fix and the pyOpenSSL>=24.3.0 branch simplifications (previously 'no cover') belong.

scrapy.utils._compression has no dedicated test module at the base commit; the _inflate() infinite-loop fix for deflate data followed by extra bytes is a direct unit-level regression test for that module.

Existing integration tests for the HTTP compression middleware already import _DecompressionMaxSizeExceeded from scrapy.utils._compression and cover rawdeflate decoding plus compression-bomb max_size handling affected by the _inflate() change.
